dominant_strengths: Elegant serif headline pairs nicely with italic subtitle, lending an editorial calm to an otherwise generic UI demo
Warm cream backdrop with soft vignetting creates a refined stage that elevates simple type composition
dominant_weaknesses: Saturated primary green/blue/orange buttons clash violently with the muted bone palette, breaking the editorial tone established by typography
No actual toast notification visible — the brief's core artifact is missing, leaving only trigger buttons as evidence of the system
Buttons feel like default Bootstrap stock, undermining craft and offering zero distinctive treatment for stack, motion, or hierarchy
fix_priorities: Show the toasts themselves — stacked, with a clear visual language for severity, dismiss affordance, and timing
Desaturate or restyle the trigger buttons to harmonize with the cream palette (muted tints, paper-like fills)
Introduce a signature motion or stacking metaphor (slide, settle, blur) to justify the 'improved' label
Tighten spatial rhythm so triggers and toast preview share a deliberate composition rather than centered floating
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral is undercut by jarring button colors, behavioral is unproven without visible toasts, and reflective ambition stalls at a generic component demo.
rationale.intent_fit: Only partially — it advertises toast notifications via a title and trigger buttons but never actually displays the notification stack the brief demands.
